title: Stakeholder swipe & impact sampler (quick scan)
content:
Purpose: one-page ad-hoc tracker used in the cross-functional standup to 'swipe' stakeholder asks and sample expected impact/cost. Not exhaustive — treats each row as a lightweight hypothesis for prioritization.

Columns: Stakeholder | Team | Primary contact | Ask (one-line) | Quick impact (user-facing) | Est effort (PDs) | Est cost delta / mo (USD) | Priority (L/M/H) | Notes & dependencies | Due

Rows:
1) Billing ops | Finance | Marco Ruiz | Short-term quota increase for trial accounts (region-eu) | Avoid rejected requests, preserves conversion for 200 trials/wk | 0.5 PD (config + rollout) | $1,200 | H | depends on routing rules in /billing-quotas (PR #1045), needs SRE approval | 2026-10-21

2) SE pilot - RetailCo | Solutions Eng | Evelyn Chen | Dedicated endpoint for RetailCo pilot (2x GPUs reserved for 3 weeks) | Keeps pilot latency SLAs, likely revenue uplift | 3 PD (infra + onboarding) | $9,600 | H | Requires dedicated pool capacity; legal NDA signed; billing PO needed | 2026-11-05

3) Observability - Traces | Observability | Samir V. | Add token-level sampling for slow-path traces (10% sample) | Better triage, reduces MTTR on tail latency incidents | 1.5 PD | $300 | M | Adds 5% storage; needs Console UI tweak; tie to eval set | 2026-10-28

4) Hosted API - Rate limiting | Hosted API | Priya Menon | White-list partner IPs for burst testing | Prevents partner throttling during integration | 0.25 PD | $0 | L | Temporary; ops change only; document in runbook | 2026-10-18

5) Dedicated - Autoscale tweak | Platform Eng | Jenna L. | Lower warmup threshold for Dedicated pools to reduce cold starts | Improves p99 latencies for bursty tenants | 2 PD | $1,800 | M | Needs performance bench (separate ticket: JIRA-4912) | 2026-11-01

6) Private Deployments - Audit | Security & Compliance | Omar N. | One-off audit across on-prem installs for KMS configuration | Compliance exposure if misconfigured | 4 PD | $0 (internal) | H | Legal and SRE to join; scheduled window required | 2026-11-15

7) Developer Experience - SDK docs | DevExp | Lila M. | Quick patch to JS SDK error messaging for quota errors | Decreases support tickets; better DX | 0.75 PD | $0 | M | Small PR; can be shipped in next minor | 2026-10-22

8) Growth - Embedding credits | Growth | Noah P. | Temporary promo credits for embedding pilot customers | Short-term usage bump; unproven LTV | 0.5 PD | $4,500 | L | Needs finance approval; set hard spend cap | 2026-10-31

Quick tallies (very rough):
- Total PDs if all accepted: 13.25 PD (~2.3 engineer-weeks)
- Total near-term cost delta/mo (cash): ~$17,400 (largest line is RetailCo reserved GPUs + Growth credits)
- Number of H priorities: 3  (Billing ops quota, SE pilot, Security audit)

Heuristics used for priority: H = customer revenue/regulatory risk or large conversion impact; M = operational quality improvements; L = low impact or purely documentation.

Top recommended actions (by urgency):
- Billing ops quota (owner: Marco) — approve config change + SRE quick check (owner SRE oncall). Target: 2026-10-18.
- SE pilot (owner: Evelyn) — confirm GPU pool booking and PO; finance to sign off by 10/20.
- Security audit (owner: Omar) — schedule kickoff meeting; include Legal + SRE; freeze further on-prem pushes until audit window confirmed.

Open questions / unknowns:
- RetailCo pilot: exact GPU type requested (A10 vs A100) — cost variance large. Evelyn to confirm vendor ask.
- Autoscale tweak: what is measurable p99 improvement baseline? Platform Eng to run two short bench runs (JIRA-4912).
- Embedding credits: define hard cap and expiry window; Finance to recommend threshold.

Slack thread snapshots / quick refs:
- Billing quota discussion: https://redwood.slack.com/archives/C02ABC123/p1634123456000500
- RetailCo pilot kickoff notes: doc link in Confluence: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/INF/RetailCo+pilot

One-paragraph summary for standup: We ran a quick swipe of eight active asks from cross-functional partners. If we greenlight everything we see ~2.3 engineer-weeks of incremental effort and ~$17k/mo additional spend (mostly pilot GPUs and promo credits). Three items are high priority: billing quota fix (blocks trial conversions), SE pilot capacity booking (revenue-critical), and on-prem KMS audit (security/regulatory). Immediate next steps: Marco to push the billing config change, Evelyn to confirm GPU spec and PO, Omar to schedule audit kickoff.

This sheet is intentionally short-form — use as a live pivot list in the standup. Mark rows DONE/WAITING/IN-PROGRESS in the 'Notes' cell as we go.

Revision history: 2026-10-14 created by Aisha; 2026-10-15 quick cost update after Evelyn confirmed 2x A10 reservations (updated cost line).
